name: object_color
description: Name the typical colour of a familiar object (banana->yellow, grass->green). Control: same sentences asking for the object's category (fruit, plant...).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
O=[('banana','yellow','fruit'),('lemon','yellow','fruit'),('grass','green','plant'),('snow','white','weather'),('coal','black','mineral'),('blood','red','liquid'),('the sky','blue','place'),('a tomato','red','vegetable'),('milk','white','drink'),('a carrot','orange','vegetable'),('an orange','orange','fruit'),('a strawberry','red','fruit'),('a lime','green','fruit'),('chocolate','brown','food'),('a crow','black','bird'),('a flamingo','pink','bird'),('the ocean','blue','place'),('a cucumber','green','vegetable'),('an eggplant','purple','vegetable'),('a polar bear','white','animal'),('a frog','green','animal'),('a pumpkin','orange','vegetable'),('ink','black','liquid'),('a fire truck','red','vehicle'),('a school bus','yellow','vehicle'),('a cherry','red','fruit'),('a lettuce','green','vegetable'),('sugar','white','food'),('a raven','black','bird'),('a sunflower','yellow','plant'),('a grape','purple','fruit'),('soil','brown','mineral'),('a canary','yellow','bird'),('a pea','green','vegetable'),('cocoa','brown','drink')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    sh=random.sample(O,3); q=random.choice([o for o in O if o not in sh])
    cap=lambda s:s[0].upper()+s[1:]
    p=''.join(f"Q: What color is {o[0]}?\nA: {o[1]}\n" for o in sh)+f"Q: What color is {q[0]}?\nA:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+q[1]})
    p2=''.join(f"Q: What kind of thing is {o[0]}?\nA: {o[2]}\n" for o in sh)+f"Q: What kind of thing is {q[0]}?\nA:"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":" "+q[2]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
